text:
maria p.: quick design question — for the usage table compact view, i'm thinking a collapsed "token rollup" cell that expands on hover/click into the mini ledger. needs to work for org vs project scope.
josh (design): prototype up: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/token-rollup — hover shows summary + last-30d sparkline, click opens invoice drawer. thinking: hover = preview (no focus), click = persistent panel (focusable).
sam (frontend): FYI if hover reveals DOM-heavy sparkline for 200 rows we'll blow up paints. can we lazy-render sparkline svg only on hover (or use canvas batching)?
maria p.: good call. pref to keep hover lightweight — only text summary + micro-sparkline placeholder. real sparkline loads after 120ms or on focus.
ajsha (pm) correction: @aisha (pm) — we should consider keyboard users: hover previews aren't accessible. need same access via keyboard focus and a11y labels.
aisha (pm): yes — keyboard + screenreader parity required. suggestion: preview triggered by focus on a dedicated button inside the cell. aria label: `Open usage preview for {scope} token breakdown` and the button should have role="button" and aria-expanded states.
josh (design): agree. visual idea: show chevron → on hover show small caret tooltip; on focus show 1px outline + visible preview. Also we need hover vs focus animation to be subtle (150ms) — don't move layout.
sam (frontend): implementation plan: render lightweight <div class="preview-shell"> on hover/focus; only fetch and hydrate sparkline/svg on `mouseenter` OR `focus` OR after a11y-only key events. will ship with `prefers-reduced-motion` support.
rajesh (infra): perf caveat — if we fetch invoice snippets for each hover we could spike backend QPS. pls use local cache (LRU per user) and TTL 5m, and debounce requests per cell (250ms). also rate-limit preview API.
maria p.: noted. aisha can we A/B test preview-on-hover vs explicit preview-button? i'd like data on accidental opens causing noise.
aisha (pm): yes — experiment: cohort A = hover+focus preview, cohort B = explicit button only. metrics: preview-open rate, invoice-open rate, subsequent click-to-download, backend qps.
josh (design): copy nit: in the preview header use "Token breakdown — last 30 days" not "Usage". keep tokens plural to match invoices. microcopy for the button: "Preview" — simple.
sam (frontend): small implementation question — what should the keyboard flow be? tab into cell -> preview button -> press Enter/Space opens persistent drawer. Escape closes. Focus returns to preview button.
maria p.: that's good. add aria-describedby pointing to hidden summary text for screenreaders: `aria-describedby="token-preview-summary-{rowId}"`.
rajesh (infra): also send a metric event `billing.preview.view` with scope + method (hover | keyboard | click) so we can check accidental opens.
ui-ci-bot: :white_check_mark: prototype tests passed: staging build 2026-03-22_18:09 — preview-shell render smoke ✅
sam (frontend): one more tiny ask — when in org scope, the preview should show top-3 projects and their token splits. in project scope, show top-3 endpoints. keep rows consistent height.
josh (design): layout note — don't show full invoice link in preview to avoid CTA confusion. show "View invoice" as tertiary link in drawer only.
maria p.: ok i'll update the figma and create the experiment ticket. @sam can you estimate frontend effort? rahesh can you set throttle rules for the preview API?
sam (frontend): estimate: small feature flag rollout + preview-shell + sparklines lazy load ~ 3 dev days.
rajesh (infra): will add LRU cache + rate-limits, estimate 1 day infra work.
aisha (pm): thanks team. action items: josh updates figma, maria creates experiment ticket with metrics, sam + rajesh implement with feature flag, i'll coordinate rollout window.
maria p.: thanks all — i'll post updated figma + ticket later today. :sparkles:
